Streaming accuracy depends on what supervision asks the model to keep, what evidence inference exposes, and whether the model keeps a correct answer once it has one.

ru.title: Учить модель помнить важное и смотреть на нужные кадры
ru.desc: Статья показывает, что в стриминговом распознавании действий модели часто не различают порядок событий, их количество и связи между ними, что названо under-specification. Авторы предлагают Visible-State Supervision (ViSS): обучение на probe-вопросах о событиях, порядке, накоплении и достаточности ответа, что особенно помогает в детекции галлюцинаций. Затем Test-Time Causal View Search (TVS) при фиксированной модели адаптивно расширяет доступ к данным от последних кадров к разреженным событийным и сжатым историческим представлениям, что улучшает recall событий и forward reasoning. Вместе эти методы разделяют обучение представлений и выбор видов, достигая лучших результатов на StreamingBench и OVO-Bench при значительно меньшем числе обработанных кадров.

en.title: Teach the model what matters, then show it the right frames
en.desc: The paper studies streaming action recognition, where a model must identify actions from video as it arrives. Visible-State Supervision (ViSS) trains the model to track event identity, order, accumulation, and relations, reducing cases where different histories look equivalent to the model. Test-Time Causal View Search (TVS) keeps the trained model fixed but selects additional evidence views, such as sparse events or a compact history, when needed. Together, ViSS and TVS improve benchmark accuracy while processing fewer frames than exhaustive view selection, and the study finds that models also need to avoid replacing a correct answer with a wrong one.

zh.title: 教模型看懂状态，按需寻找证据
zh.desc: 这篇论文研究流式动作识别：模型逐步接收视频帧，需要边看边回答问题。可见状态监督（ViSS）通过训练模型识别事件、顺序、累积和关系变化，减少只给出相同答案却忽略不同事件历史造成的状态欠指定。测试时因果视图搜索（TVS）保持模型不变，按需从近期帧扩展到稀疏事件和精简历史视图，从而选择更合适的证据。两种方法互相补充，在基准测试中提升准确率并减少处理帧数；论文还发现，模型有时会用错误答案替换先前已经给出的正确答案。

papers.title: MemSteer: Turning User Histories into Supervision for Agent Memory Optimization
papers.abstract: Abstract MemSteer generates evidence-grounded QA supervision from unlabeled user histories to optimize agent memory design without model updates, improving benchmark scores significantly.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small An effective agent memory system should adapt to a user's history and task requirements. Human-annotated supervision can guide this adaptation by providing feedback for evaluating and improving memory designs. Yet suitable labels are rarely available for new user histories, and manually constructing QA pairs and supporting evidence is costly. We introduce MemSteer, which turns unlabeled user histories into question-answer (QA) supervision with supporting evidence for memory-design optimization. MemSteer constructs an evidence-grounded answer plan that specifies how facts across related records jointly support a reference answer. The plan guides question generation, while source-grounded auditing and blind answer recovery check the resulting annotations. To study the utility of this supervision, we develop MemSteer-Opt, which combines QA-based design evaluation with evidence-guided failure diagnosis to revise memory store, retrieval, and context construction without updating model parameters. Experiments on ATM-Bench and RHELM show that this supervision is competitive with official-QA-guided optimization. Relative to Base-BM25, MemSteer-Opt improves ATM-Bench Question Score by 13.4 points and RHELM accuracy by 4.1 and 6.6 points without and with external data, respectively. The supervision also benefits two existing optimizers on ATM-Bench, while new-user experiments demonstrate continued design optimization using supervision generated from the target histories.

ru.title: Память агента учится на собственной истории без разметки
ru.desc: В статье представлен MemSteer, метод, который генерирует вопросно-ответные (QA) данные с опорой на доказательства из неразмеченных истории пользователей. Система строит план ответа, связывающий факты из разных записей, а затем проверяет аннотации через аудит по источникам и слепое восстановление ответа. Далее MemSteer-Opt использует эти QA-данные и диагностику ошибок для улучшения хранилища памяти, механизма поиска и построения контекста агента без обновления параметров LLM. Эксперименты на ATM-Bench и RHELM показывают значительный прирост качества относительно базового BM25.

en.title: Turn user histories into evidence that steers better agent memory
en.desc: MemSteer creates question-and-answer training examples from unlabeled user histories, along with evidence showing which records support each answer. It uses an evidence-based answer plan to guide question writing, then checks the examples through source audits and attempts to recover answers without seeing the questions. MemSteer-Opt uses this supervision to evaluate and improve how an agent stores, retrieves, and assembles memories, without changing the model’s parameters. Experiments on ATM-Bench and RHELM show improved performance over a BM25 baseline, and the generated supervision can also help other memory optimizers.

zh.title: 从用户历史生成证据监督，让智能体记忆无需更新模型也能持续优化
zh.desc: MemSteer 从未标注的用户历史中生成带有证据支持的问答监督数据，用来优化智能体的记忆设计。它先制定证据答案计划，说明多条相关记录如何共同支持答案，再据此生成问题，并通过来源核查和盲答恢复检查标注质量。MemSteer-Opt 利用这些问答评估记忆设计、诊断失败原因，并调整记忆存储、检索和上下文构建，而无需更新模型参数。在 ATM-Bench 和 RHELM 上，该方法取得了有竞争力的结果，并显著优于 Base-BM25；新用户实验也表明，它能利用目标用户历史持续优化记忆设计。

papers.title: No Channels Left Behind: Understanding Diffusion Acceleration through Residual Gates
papers.abstract: Abstract Training acceleration in diffusion transformers is driven by reorganization of AdaLN-Zero residual gates, and a simple radial objective promoting broader gate participation improves generation quality without auxiliary teachers.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Training acceleration methods for diffusion transformers, such as REPA and dispersive regularization, are commonly explained by additional supervision, spatial-structure priors, or improved feature geometry. We revisit this view and uncover a striking internal change: the AdaLN-Zero residual gate α, which directly controls how conditioned updates enter the residual stream, is substantially reorganized by these methods. This observation motivates our hypothesis that acceleration arises, at least in part, from reshaping the residual gating pathway rather than solely from the feature structures explicitly imposed by auxiliary objectives. Supporting this view, accelerated models are markedly more sensitive to perturbations of α, and their gate geometry reflects semantic relationships among classes. We further introduce the normalized participation ratio (nPR) to characterize the channel-wise organization of the gates and find that, across REPA teachers, projector architectures, and radial-objective targets, broader gate participation accompanies better generation quality. Guided by this insight, we propose a simple teacher-free radial objective that promotes broader gate participation through feature-norm regularization, without pairwise feature comparisons. On ImageNet 256times256 with SiT-B/2, our method improves FID over dispersive loss while increasing mean gate participation over timesteps and classes, further supporting the link between gate organization and training acceleration. Our results identify residual-gate reorganization as a measurable axis of diffusion training acceleration and suggest a simple direction for further acceleration.

ru.title: Ускорение диффузии начинается с перестройки residual gates
ru.desc: Авторы показывают, что методы ускорения обучения диффузионных трансформеров (REPA, dispersive loss) заметно перестраивают AdaLN-Zero residual gate α, который управляет тем, как условные обновления попадают в residual stream. Для описания организации каналов гейтов вводится нормализованный participation ratio (nPR), и оказывается, что более широкое участие гейтов связано с лучшим качеством генерации. На основе этого предлагается простой teacher-free радиальный регуляризатор, который через норму признаков расширяет участие гейтов без попарных сравнений признаков. На ImageNet 256×256 с SiT-B/2 метод улучшает FID по сравнению с dispersive loss.

en.title: Broader Residual-Gate Participation for Better Diffusion Models
en.desc: The paper studies how training acceleration methods affect diffusion transformers. It finds that these methods reorganize AdaLN-Zero residual gates, which control how conditioned updates enter the residual stream, and that broader participation across gate channels is linked to better image generation quality. The authors measure this organization with normalized participation ratio (nPR) and introduce a teacher-free radial objective that encourages broader gate participation through feature-norm regularization. On ImageNet, the method improves FID over dispersive loss, suggesting that residual-gate organization is an important part of training acceleration.

zh.title: 拓宽残差门控参与，让扩散模型训练更快、生成更好
zh.desc: 这篇论文研究扩散 Transformer 的训练加速机制，发现 AdaLN-Zero 中控制条件信息进入残差流的门控参数 α 会发生明显重组。加速模型对 α 的扰动更敏感，而且门控结构能反映类别之间的语义关系。作者提出归一化参与率（nPR）来衡量门控在不同通道上的分布，并发现门控参与范围越广，生成质量往往越好。基于此，作者设计了无需教师模型的径向目标，通过特征范数正则化扩大门控参与范围，并在 ImageNet 实验中取得优于 dispersive loss 的 FID。

papers.title: RoboArchitect: Automating the Design of Robotic Agents with Persistent Memory
papers.abstract: Abstract RoboArchitect automates robot harness design by iteratively revising control code around a frozen policy, substantially improving success on unseen scenes and tasks without model updates.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Recent work shows that a frozen robot policy performs far better inside an agent harness, where control code decides when to query the policy, consult vision tools, or command the arm directly. Yet today these harnesses are built by hand and redesigned for each new robot or benchmark. We show that harness design can be automated, offering a strong alternative to finetuning on a novel setup. In RoboArchitect, a coding model observes a robot's rollouts, diagnoses failures, and iteratively revises the harness around the frozen policy. The harness evolves on a set of episodes for its optimization and is evaluated on held-out scenes and tasks. Without updating any model weights, RoboArchitect raises average success from 9.7% to 43.3% on unseen scenes (4.5x) and from 12.7% to 40.2% on unseen tasks (3.2x), across multiple benchmarks and policies. The gains are largest where the benchmark is far from the policy's training data: wrapping a general-purpose policy, the evolved harness yields a specialist that often outperforms even the finetuned version. Intuitive control strategies are automatically designed, such as lifting a jammed arm clear or reaching in horizontally when an obstacle blocks the way from above. The harness also evolves its own persistent memory, carrying learned experience, such as effective grasp depths, into later decisions. These results suggest that substantial headroom in robotic manipulation lies in the agent harness, and its design can be effectively automated and optimized without weight updates.

ru.title: Умная обвязка важнее дообучения: робот учится без смены весов
ru.desc: В статье представлен RoboArchitect — метод автоматического проектирования агентной обвязки (harness) вокруг замороженной робото-политики. LLM-модель анализирует траектории робота, диагностирует ошибки и итеративно переписывает управляющий код, который решает, когда опрашивать политику, использовать компьютерное зрение или напрямую управлять манипулятором. Без обновления весов модели успешность выполнения задач выросла с 9,7% до 43,3% на новых сценах и с 12,7% до 40,2% на новых задачах, причём harness дополнительно формирует собственную persistent memory. Результаты показывают, что значительный потенциал улучшения робототехники лежит в дизайне harness, а не только в дообучении (finetuning).

en.title: Better Robot Skills Without Updating the Model
en.desc: RoboArchitect improves a frozen robot policy by automatically revising the control code, or harness, that decides how the robot acts. A coding model examines robot rollouts, identifies failures, and updates the harness without changing the policy’s model weights. Across benchmarks, this approach raises success on unseen scenes from 9.7% to 43.3% and on unseen tasks from 12.7% to 40.2%. The harness can also develop useful control strategies and preserve experience in memory, suggesting that harness optimization is a strong alternative to finetuning.

zh.title: 不改模型权重，也能让机器人越做越好
zh.desc: RoboArchitect 自动优化机器人智能体的控制框架（harness），而不是更新冻结策略的模型权重。一个编程模型观察机器人执行任务的过程，诊断失败，并反复修改控制代码，包括何时调用策略、使用视觉工具或直接控制机械臂。实验显示，这种方法显著提升了机器人在未见场景和任务中的成功率，有时甚至超过微调后的策略。框架还会形成持久记忆，保存有效的抓取深度等经验，供后续决策使用。

papers.title: SOMA: A Benchmark for Fine-Grained Egocentric Behavior and Body-Motion Understanding
papers.abstract: Abstract SOMA is a benchmark assessing fine-grained egocentric body-motion reasoning in multimodal models, revealing substantial gaps versus human performance and providing training data and a multimodal baseline to advance the field.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Perceiving human body motion is critical for multimodal systems that understand and assist people. Yet current evaluations of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) largely focus on objects, scenes, and coarse actions, leaving their ability to reason about the body itself poorly assessed. This is especially challenging from the egocentric perspective, in which the body is only partially visible and motion must be inferred from occluded and temporally distributed cues. We introduce SOMA, a benchmark for fine-grained body-motion understanding from egocentric video, comprising 1,632 human-verified questions across three capability axes: body configuration, motion dynamics, and temporal reasoning. We evaluate 37 leading closed-source, open-source, and specialized egocentric MLLMs, complemented by an extensive human evaluation. We find that humans also find this task difficult from video alone (68.5% accuracy), yet clearly outperform the strongest MLLM (Qwen3.6-27B), which reaches 50.0% zero-shot accuracy. Our error analysis shows that MLLMs often misread the wearer's own body, misjudge events in time, and are prone to biases such as favoring the right hand or under-counting repetitions. To narrow the gap to human performance and support further progress, we introduce a training dataset of aligned video, body motion, and language supervision, and a multimodal baseline that jointly learns from these modalities. By identifying common failure modes and missing capabilities in current MLLMs, we hope SOMA will inspire future research on body-motion understanding and multimodal reasoning. Full benchmark, training data, and code will be released at: https://cnai.epfl.ch/soma
affiliations: Ecole Polytechnique Federale de Lausanne (EPFL), Switzerland

ru.title: Модели видят видео, но ещё не понимают движения человеческого тела
ru.desc: Статья представляет SOMA — бенчмарк для оценки понимания тонких движений человеческого тела по egocentric видео, состоящий из 1632 проверенных вопросов по трём осям: конфигурация тела, динамика движения и временное рассуждение. Авторы тестируют 37 MLLM и показывают, что лучшая модель (Qwen3.6-27B) достигает 50% точности в режиме zero-shot, тогда как люди — 68.5%. Анализ ошибок выявляет проблемы модели: неверное восприятие собственного тела, ошибки во временной привязке событий и систематические смещения, например, предпочтение правой руки или занижение числа повторов. Для сокращения разрыва авторы публикуют обучающий датасет с выровненными видео, данными о движении и языковой разметкой, а также мультимодальный baseline.

en.title: SOMA: A Benchmark to Help AI Read the Body in Motion
en.desc: The paper introduces SOMA, a benchmark for testing whether multimodal large language models can understand detailed body movements from first-person video. Its 1,632 human-verified questions test body configuration, motion dynamics, and temporal reasoning. Across 37 models, the strongest model scores 50% accuracy, below human performance at 68.5%, with errors including misreading the wearer’s body and misjudging timing or repetition. The authors also provide aligned video, body-motion, and language training data, plus a multimodal baseline to help improve these capabilities.

zh.title: 看懂第一人称视角下的身体动作，弥合模型与人的差距
zh.desc: 本文提出 SOMA 基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型从第一人称视频理解细粒度身体动作的能力。基准包含 1,632 道经人工验证的问题，涵盖身体姿态、动作变化和时间推理三个方面，并对 37 种模型进行了评测。人类准确率为 68.5%，表现最好的模型零样本准确率为 50.0%；模型常误读佩戴者自身的身体、判断错事件时间，也会出现偏向右手或少算重复次数等偏差。研究还提供配有视频、身体动作与语言标注的训练数据，以及联合学习这些模态的基线模型，以推动相关能力提升。

papers.title: Think Twice: The Metis-1.6 Technical Report
papers.abstract: Abstract Metis-1.6 introduces small, efficient mixture-of-experts language models trained with limited data that achieve competitive math performance and Pareto-optimal efficiency despite training errors and architectural issues.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Metis is a bet that better data, better training methods and new architectures can buy what a bigger parameter count cannot, at a fraction of the cost. Metis-1.6 is its latest step: two language models built from scratch by a single researcher, Praxis (2.94B parameters, 0.46B active per pass) and Logos (10.23B parameters, 1.18B active per pass). Both run a hybrid Mamba-2 and attention mixture-of-experts stack twice for every token, so each token gets a second look. Each was trained on 1.02T tokens in total: 804.76B of pretraining, 18B of context extension to 131,072 tokens, and 200B of supervised fine-tuning. Metis-1.6 was never meant to challenge frontier models, and across 40 post-trained benchmarks it mostly does not: Logos averages 52.93, seventh of 17 models in its comparison set and within a point of Qwen3-4B. But it gets there on roughly a twelfth of the median training data of the comparators that disclose it, and with fewer active parameters per token than any model that beats it, which puts it on the Pareto frontier for both. In mathematics it ranks second of 30 models, with 67.50% on AIME 2025 and 63.64% on HMMT February 2026. It is weak at code, instruction following and long context. The rest of the report is the part I found most valuable: what went wrong. The optimizer I configured never ran, and attention trained with AdamW for all of pretraining. A 1.77B-parameter n-gram memory learned to switch itself off. Five fine-tuning choices cost capability. And a length reward under group-mean normalization punished correct solutions for being long once a group's pass rate passed 2/3, a sign inversion I prove and fix with a one-line clamp. I close with the 10B-token ablations behind MoRE (Mixture of Recursive Experts), the looped architecture of Metis-1.7.

ru.title: Меньше параметров, больше данных и аккуратности: маленькая модель, которая считает не хуже больших
ru.desc: Статья представляет Metis-1.6 — пару компактных языковых моделей Praxis (2.94B параметров) и Logos (10.23B параметров), построенных на гибридной архитектуре Mamba-2 и attention с mixture-of-experts и обученных на 1.02T токенов. Модели уступают крупным frontier-моделям в большинстве бенчмарков, но показывают второе место среди 30 моделей в математике (AIME 2025, HMMT) и выходят на Pareto-фронтьер по соотношению качества, объёма данных и активных параметров. Авторы подробно разбирают ошибки обучения: неработавший оптимизатор, AdamW для attention, отключившуюся n-gram память и инверсию знака в length reward при group-mean нормализации, которую они доказали и исправили. В завершение приведены ablation-эксперименты с MoRE (Mixture of Recursive Experts) для будущей версии Metis-1.7.

en.title: Smarter training and architecture can make small models punch above their weight
en.desc: Metis-1.6 presents two small mixture-of-experts language models built from scratch using a hybrid Mamba-2 and attention architecture. Despite training on much less data and using fewer active parameters per token than comparable models, they achieve competitive results, especially in mathematics. The paper also explains why the models remain weak in areas such as coding, instruction following, and long-context tasks, and describes training mistakes that limited their performance. Finally, it reports experiments that motivate MoRE, a recursive expert architecture planned for Metis-1.7.

zh.title: 少数据、高效率：小模型也能在数学推理中脱颖而出
zh.desc: 论文介绍了从零训练的两个小型混合专家语言模型，采用 Mamba-2 与注意力混合架构，并让每个词元经过两轮处理。尽管训练数据比同类模型少得多，Logos 仍在总体表现与每词元激活参数效率之间达到帕累托前沿，并在数学基准上名列前茅。论文也坦诚分析了训练中的问题，包括预设优化器未能运行、部分微调选择削弱能力，以及长度奖励在特定条件下反向惩罚正确的长答案。作者还通过消融实验介绍了后续递归专家混合架构 MoRE 的设计依据。

papers.title: VoxLock: Target-Speaker Extraction for Voice Agents Without an Enrollment Step
papers.abstract: Abstract A fine-tuned causal target-speaker extraction model achieves near-commercial speech recognition accuracy on real recordings with low CPU usage and latency.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small A voice agent's speech recognizer transcribes everyone near the microphone, including people other than the caller. I fine-tuned a public causal target-speaker extraction model (REAL-TSE, 27M parameters) on one GPU to work from a voice sample cut from the call itself, and released it as VoxLock. I score it by what a recognizer writes on real recordings. On Krisp's 265-recording benchmark it reaches 4.95% WER against 23.21% unprocessed and lets 9 background words into the transcript over 85 minutes of background-only speech. Its WER is not significantly different from Krisp's best filters and is significantly lower than the other commercial and open systems I tested. On 400 AMI meeting windows built and frozen before scoring, it cuts WER from 42.95% to 10.63%. The 8-bit model runs a live call on 77% of one CPU thread with 24 ms of algorithmic latency. Model, code and per-file scores are open.

ru.title: Слышим только звонящего: голос в шумной комнате без лишних слов
ru.desc: Авторы дообучили каузальную модель выделения целевого диктора REAL-TSE (27 млн параметров) на одном GPU, используя голосовой образец, взятый из самого звонка. Модель, названная VoxLock, подавляет речь посторонних людей, которую распознаватель иначе транскрибирует. На бенчмарке Krisp WER снижается с 23.21% до 4.95%, что сопоставимо с лучшими коммерческими фильтрами. Квантованная 8-битная версия работает в реальном времени на одном CPU-потоке с задержкой 24 мс.

en.title: Lock on to the caller, leave background voices behind
en.desc: The paper fine-tunes REAL-TSE, a causal target-speaker extraction model, to isolate a caller’s voice using a voice sample taken from the call. The resulting 27-million-parameter model, VoxLock, is evaluated by the word error rate (WER) of a speech recognizer on real recordings. It achieves 4.95% WER on Krisp’s benchmark and reduces WER from 42.95% to 10.63% on AMI meeting audio, while strongly suppressing background speech. Its 8-bit version runs in real time using 77% of one CPU thread with 24 ms of algorithmic latency.

zh.title: 锁定目标说话人，让实时语音识别更准确
zh.desc: 这篇论文将一个公开的因果式目标说话人提取模型 REAL-TSE 微调为 VoxLock，使其能够根据通话中的一段语音样本，只提取目标说话人的声音。作者通过语音识别系统在真实录音上的词错误率（WER）评估效果：在 Krisp 的 265 段录音上，WER 从未处理时的 23.21% 降至 4.95%，在 AMI 会议片段上则从 42.95% 降至 10.63%。测试还显示，它能有效压制背景说话人的语音，效果与 Krisp 的最佳滤波器相当，并优于作者测试的其他商用和开源系统。经过 8 位量化后，该模型仅使用单个 CPU 线程约 77% 的算力，算法延迟为 24 毫秒，适合实时通话。

papers.title: SciGame: Let Agents Play the Scientific Discovery Games in the Real and Counterfactual World
papers.abstract: Abstract SciGame evaluates scientific discovery agents using structured cards with counterfactual environments to separate prior knowledge from empirical evidence, revealing that exact symbolic law recovery remains a key challenge.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Large language model agents are increasingly used for scientific discovery. However, existing benchmarks mix law inference with programming, score data fitting instead of prediction on unseen inputs, and do not separate empirical evidence from pretrained priors. We introduce SciGame, a controlled benchmark that converts scientific literature into structured scientific cards. Each card yields a pair of Original and dimensionally consistent Counterfactual environments with the same task interface. SciGame contains a Historical collection of canonical laws and a live Temporal collection curated from papers published after model knowledge cutoffs. It evaluates agents in candidate-guided Identification and open-ended Discovery settings. Each setting runs under Prior-only, Fixed, and Adaptive protocols. Experiments on five frontier models yield three findings. First, familiar priors hurt performance once the governing relation is altered. Second, adaptive experimentation helps the strongest models but harms weaker ones under limited budgets. Third, good explanations can hide quantitative failures. Recovering the exact symbolic form remains the main bottleneck, even when agents interpret evidence correctly. Current agents can investigate systems actively, but inducing exact laws in unfamiliar settings remains an open challenge.

ru.title: Агенты умеют исследовать, но точный закон в незнакомых условиях вывести пока не могут
ru.desc: В статье представлен SciGame — контролируемый бенчмарк для оценки LLM-агентов в задачах научного открытия. Литературные источники преобразуются в структурированные научные карточки, из которых строятся оригинальная и контрфактическая среды с одинаковым интерфейсом, что позволяет отделить априорные знания модели от эмпирических данных. Эксперименты с пятью передовыми моделями показали, что привычные априорные знания мешают при изменении управляющих зависимостей, а адаптивное экспериментирование помогает сильнейшим моделям, но вредит слабым. Главным узким местом остаётся точное восстановление символьной формы закона, даже когда агенты правильно интерпретируют данные.

en.title: Test the evidence, not just the prior: exact scientific laws remain hard to discover
en.desc: SciGame is a benchmark for testing whether AI agents can discover scientific laws from evidence rather than rely on what they learned during training. It uses structured scientific cards to create original environments and dimensionally consistent counterfactuals, and tests both familiar laws and findings published after models’ training cutoffs. Agents are evaluated through candidate-guided identification and open-ended discovery, using protocols that vary how much prior knowledge and experimentation they can use. Results show that familiar knowledge can mislead agents, adaptive experiments help only the strongest models, and recovering an exact symbolic law remains difficult even when explanations sound convincing.

zh.title: 能探索，更要发现：让智能体从证据中还原精确科学定律
zh.desc: 本文提出 SciGame，一个用于评估科学发现智能体的可控基准测试。它把科学文献整理成结构化卡片，并为每个任务构建原始环境和量纲一致的反事实环境，以区分模型的先验知识与实验所得证据。基准测试包含候选引导的识别和开放式发现任务，并通过不同实验协议评估智能体。结果表明，主动实验对强模型有帮助，却可能损害弱模型的表现；即使解释合理，模型仍常无法准确恢复规律的符号形式。

papers.title: CausalWAM: Learning the Causes of Actions in World Action Models
papers.abstract: Abstract Causal World Action Models enforce sparse routing to isolate action-relevant latent variables, ensuring identifiable causal structure without requiring temporal independence assumptions.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small World action models (WAMs) learn latent variables from observations and use these to both predict the evolution of the scene and to generate actions. The prediction has to be of the whole scene, whereas only a portion of the scene causes actions. WAMs fitted to demonstrations do not, in general, guarantee that they will generate actions solely from the latent causes of the demonstrated actions (the action-relevant latent variables), as the model could just as well learn to imitate in this way whilst entangling the action-relevant latent variables with the nuisance variables. We therefore separate out what causes action from what prediction depends on. We prove that under a sparsity constraint the latent variables used to generate actions are an invertible function of the action-relevant latent variables alone and the true structure is identified up to a permutation of the latent variables. This requires neither sufficient temporal dependence nor any assumptions on how the unobserved regimes evolve and holds even when the action-relevant latent variables are statistically dependent on the rest. We therefore propose CWAM (Causal WAM), which incorporates the constraint into a pretrained WAM by adding a sparse routing path to its action head, with the world modeling objective remaining unchanged. Experiments on both synthetic data and real-world robots validate the theory as well as showcase the improved efficiency in closed-loop success.

ru.title: Действия только из истинных причин: causal-структура для роботов
ru.desc: В статье предлагается Causal WAM (CWAM) — модель мира для действий, которая разделяет латентные переменные, влияющие на действия, и те, от которых зависит предсказание сцены. Авторы вводят ограничение разреженности (sparsity), которое направляет генерацию действий только через action-relevant латентные переменные. Доказано, что при таком ограничении истинная causal структура идентифицируема с точностью до перестановки переменных, без требований о временной зависимости. Эксперименты на синтетических данных и реальных роботах подтверждают теорию и показывают повышение эффективности closed-loop успешности.

en.title: Route Actions Through Their True Causes
en.desc: World action models learn latent variables to predict how a scene changes and to choose actions. However, a model trained from demonstrations may mix variables that cause actions with irrelevant details, making its actions depend on nuisance variables. Causal WAM adds sparse routing to the action-generation path, so the action inputs identify the action-relevant latent variables up to a permutation, without requiring temporal independence. Tests on synthetic data and real robots support the theory and show improved efficiency in closed-loop task success.

zh.title: 让动作只听从真正相关的潜在因素
zh.desc: 世界动作模型（WAM）从观测中学习潜在变量，用来预测场景变化并生成动作，但普通模型可能把动作相关因素与无关因素混在一起。论文提出因果世界动作模型（CWAM），在动作生成部分加入稀疏路由，使模型只使用与动作有关的潜在变量。理论证明，在稀疏约束下，动作所用的潜在变量可唯一确定到变量排列，且不需要假设潜在变量在时间上相互独立。合成数据和真实机器人实验表明，CWAM符合理论预期，并能提高闭环任务的成功效率。

papers.title: GEPA-Curator: Curated Learning for Self Improving Agents
papers.abstract: Abstract GEPA-Curator improves agentic prompt optimization by filtering unreliable failure signals and retrieving past successes, boosting performance across multiple benchmarks.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in multi-turn agentic workloads that require sustained interaction with complex environments. Existing reflective prompt optimizers such as GEPA learn from failed rollouts, but agentic failures can also come from prompt weaknesses, harness limitations, stochastic execution, or noisy judges. We argue that such failures may not provide useful learning signal, and may even be harmful; and thus it is essential to curate which tasks are provided to the prompt optimizer for better performance. We introduce GEPA-Curator, a framework that augments the prompt optimizer to select which agent experiences should shape prompt optimization. In particular, GEPA-Curator consists of two components: task curation, which filters out tasks that are likely to provide noisy or unreliable learning signals, and prior success retrieval, which selectively retrieves past successful trajectories for a task and provides them as additional context to the prompt optimizer. We evaluate GEPA-Curator on GoBrowse, ALFWorld, AppWorld, and τ-bench, using both Gemini 3.1 Pro and Claude Opus 5 as optimizer models. GEPA-Curator matches or exceeds the mean performance of both baselines, with gains of up to 20.7% over GEPA and 21.2% over ACE.

ru.title: Учиться не на любых ошибках, а на правильных примерах
ru.desc: Статья предлагает GEPA-Curator, фреймворк для улучшения оптимизации промптов у агентных LLM, которые работают в многошаговых сценариях. Авторы замечают, что неудачные траектории выполнения задач могут содержать шумные или ненадёжные сигналы обучения, поэтому полезно отбирать задачи для оптимизатора. Метод состоит из двух частей: task curation отфильтровывает задачи с нестабильными сигналами, а prior success retrieval извлекает прошлые успешные траектории и передаёт их как дополнительный контекст. Эксперименты на бенчмарках GoBrowse, ALFWorld, AppWorld и τ-bench показывают, что подход достигает или превосходит базовые методы GEPA и ACE, с приростом до 20.7% и 21.2%.

en.title: Learn from Reliable Failures—and Reuse What Worked
en.desc: GEPA-Curator improves agentic prompt optimization by choosing which task experiences the optimizer learns from. Its task curation filters out failures that may be caused by unreliable signals, such as noisy judges or execution randomness. It also retrieves relevant successful trajectories to give the optimizer useful examples. Across four benchmarks, it matched or outperformed GEPA and ACE, with gains of up to 20.7% and 21.2%, respectively.

zh.title: 筛选可靠经验，检索成功轨迹，让智能体提示优化更有效
zh.desc: 大型语言模型常用于需要与复杂环境持续多轮交互的智能体任务，提示优化器会从失败轨迹中学习。可是，失败也可能由提示、执行框架、随机性或评估器噪声造成，因此不一定是可靠的学习信号。GEPA-Curator通过任务筛选过滤不可靠的经验，并检索相关任务中过去成功的轨迹，作为提示优化的额外上下文。在四个基准测试中，它的平均表现达到或超过对比方法，最高分别比GEPA提升20.7%、比ACE提升21.2%。

papers.title: rTaste: Do Research Agents Have Taste? Evaluating Early Stage Research Judgment
papers.abstract: Abstract Frontier AI research agents propose many sound experiments but show limited ability to rank them better than simple baselines, with teams offering no clear quality gains.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Do research agents have taste, the judgment of which experiments are worth running before their outcomes are known? We give six frontier models seven recent NLP papers. Each model, working as a research agent alone or as a team, proposes minimum viable experiments (MVEs), forecasts whether each will pass a threshold it sets and ranks them. A separate executor then attempts every MVE, including those ranked last, and three model auditors judge the results. Of 415 MVEs, 194 are judged sound, valuable and new, but fewer than half of these (73) are also judged beyond the seed paper and non obvious. The agents' first choices match the auditors' most valued experiment more often than a random pick, but are not shown to improve on choosing the experiment written first. Their forecasts beat a base rate but are not measurably more accurate than those of a fresh instance of the same model given only the paper and registrations. Teams cost more without a clear overall improvement in proposal quality. The agents produce many worthwhile experiments, but the evidence that their rankings improve the choice of which to run remains limited. The evaluation harness and a dataset of all 415 MVEs, with their forecasts and audited outcomes, are available at https://github.com/ArtKanke/rTaste.

ru.title: Агенты генерируют идеи, но не умеют выбирать лучшие
ru.desc: Авторы проверяют, способны ли LLM-агенты к «research taste», то есть умению заранее оценивать, какие эксперименты стоит ставить до известного результата. Шесть frontier-моделей работали над семью NLP-статьями: предлагали minimum viable experiments, прогнозировали их успех и ранжировали. Затем executor запускал все эксперименты, а три аудитора оценивали результаты, и из 415 экспериментов лишь 73 признаны одновременно валидными, ценными, новыми и выходящими за рамки исходной работы. Ранжирование агентов лишь немного лучше случайного выбора и не превосходит выбор первого эксперимента, а прогнозы не точнее прогнозов модели без командной работы, при этом команды дороже без явного выигрыша в качестве.

en.title: AI Can Propose Experiments, but Its Research Taste Remains Unproven
en.desc: The paper tests whether AI research agents can judge which experiments are worth running before seeing their results. Six models proposed and ranked experiments based on seven NLP papers, while separate executors and auditors assessed the experiments and their outcomes. Of 415 proposed experiments, 194 were judged sound, valuable, and new, but only 73 were also considered non-obvious and beyond the original papers. The agents' rankings showed little evidence of improving experiment selection over simple baselines, and teams did not clearly improve proposal quality despite costing more.

zh.title: 实验点子不少，选得准不准仍待证明
zh.desc: 研究探讨 AI 研究智能体能否在实验结果未知时，判断哪些实验最值得开展。六种前沿模型针对七篇近期 NLP 论文提出最小可行实验，并预测和排序实验；之后，执行者尝试了全部 415 项实验，审查者评估其结果。194 项实验被认为可靠、有价值且新颖，但智能体的排序并未显示出比随机选择或优先选择先写出的实验更有优势；团队合作也没有带来明确的质量提升。总体而言，智能体能提出不少有价值的实验，但目前证据有限，无法证明它们能更好地挑选最值得执行的实验。

papers.title: TernScope: Model-Hardware Co-Design for Efficient Ternary Endoscopic Segmentation
papers.abstract: Abstract TernScope co-designs a compact ternary-weight segmentation network with simplified hardware to achieve high accuracy and fast inference for edge medical imaging.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Edge medical segmentation must reconcile small model size, high accuracy, and fast inference. TernScope addresses this tradeoff through model--hardware co-design, learning a compact segmentation network whose low-bit operators also simplify hardware execution. Split-channel large-kernel blocks preserve spatial context with limited computation, while branch fusion removes redundant inference paths. Ternary Progressive Quantization-aware Training (TPQ) then adapts the fused network from deep to shallow layers, through the decoder, and finally to the input and prediction layers. All 25 convolutions use ternary weights and 8-bit activations, enabling packed storage and multiplier-free computation. The resulting model uses 0.2483 M parameters and 0.0949 GMACs while retaining competitive segmentation accuracy on in-domain and external datasets. Under the same 45 nm technology, TernScope reduces compute-array area by 88.46% compared with the original Gemmini, a systolic-array accelerator with 8-bit times 8-bit multipliers. These results demonstrate a path from accurate lightweight medical segmentation to compact low-bit hardware.

ru.title: Точная медицинская сегментация в компактном тернарном формате
ru.desc: TernScope — это компактная сегментационная нейросеть для медицинских изображений, которая разрабатывается совместно с аппаратной частью, чтобы работать на edge-устройствах. Сеть использует тернарные веса (ternary weights) и 8-битные активации, что позволяет хранить модель в упакованном виде и вычислять без умножителей. Метод Ternary Progressive Quantization-aware Training (TPQ) постепенно адаптирует сеть к квантованию: от глубоких слоёв к поверхностным, затем к декодеру и входным и выходным слоям. Модель содержит всего 0.2483 M параметров и 0.0949 GMACs, сохраняя конкурентную точность, а вычислительный блок по сравнению с Gemmini сокращён по площади на 88.46%.

en.title: Accurate Medical Segmentation, Built for Ternary Hardware
en.desc: TernScope jointly designs a compact medical image segmentation network and its hardware to achieve efficient inference on edge devices. Split-channel large-kernel blocks preserve spatial context with low computation, and branch fusion removes redundant inference paths. Ternary Progressive Quantization-aware Training adapts the network to use ternary weights and 8-bit activations across all convolutions, reducing storage and enabling multiplier-free computation. The model retains competitive segmentation accuracy with 0.2483 million parameters and reduces compute-array area by 88.46% compared with the Gemmini accelerator.

zh.title: 协同设计，让精准医疗分割更小、更快
zh.desc: TernScope通过模型与硬件协同设计，构建适用于边缘医疗影像的轻量级图像分割网络。它采用分通道大卷积核模块保留空间上下文，并通过分支融合去除冗余计算路径。随后，渐进式三值量化感知训练从深层到浅层逐步适配网络；全部25个卷积层使用三值权重和8位激活，从而支持紧凑存储与无需乘法器的计算。该模型仅有0.2483 M个参数和0.0949 GMACs，在保持有竞争力的分割精度的同时，相比Gemmini将计算阵列面积减少88.46%。

papers.title: Learning Quality-Controllable Robot Policies with Iterative Hindsight Relabeling
papers.abstract: Abstract Quality-Controllable Policy enables real-time adjustment of robot execution quality and improves performance through iterative hindsight relabeling of online rollouts.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Robot policy evaluation often relies on a binary success signal for task completion. In real-world deployment, however, desired execution behaviors are also defined by quality attributes such as execution speed and motion smoothness, which need to be dynamically controlled according to task requirements. To address this, we introduce Quality-Controllable Policy (QCP), a robot policy that enables inference-time control over both individual quality attributes and their combinations. To extend the controllable quality range beyond initial demonstrations, we further propose an iterative hindsight relabeling loop: QCP collects online rollouts under target quality labels, adds successful trajectories to the dataset, relabels the accumulated trajectories in hindsight according to their measured quality, and fine-tunes the policy. Experiments on Robomimic and RoboEval demonstrate that QCP consistently improves both task execution quality and success rates across iterations, producing successful rollouts that exceed the quality of the initial demonstrations. Finally, we validate QCP on real-world manipulation tasks, where controlling speed increases throughput in conveyor operations and controlling transport stability improves success when carrying wine glasses, demonstrating that quality-controllable policies yield practical gains in physical deployment.

ru.title: Роботы, которые выполняют задачи не просто успешно, а с нужным качеством
ru.desc: В статье предлагается Quality-Controllable Policy (QCP) — политика робота, которая позволяет во время инференса управлять отдельными атрибутами качества выполнения, такими как скорость и плавность движения, а также их комбинациями. Для расширения диапазона управляемого качества за пределы исходных демонстраций авторы вводят итеративный цикл hindsight relabeling: онлайн-роллауты собираются под целевыми метками качества, успешные траектории добавляются в датасет, затем переразмечаются по измеренному качеству и используются для дообучения policy. Эксперименты на Robomimic и RoboEval показывают, что QCP улучшает как качество выполнения, так и success rate на каждой итерации, порождая роллауты качественнее исходных демонстраций. Валидация на реальных манипуляциях подтверждает практическую пользу: контроль скорости повышает пропускную способность конвейера, а контроль стабильности транспортировки повышает успешность при переносе бокалов для вина.

en.title: Control not only whether robots succeed, but how well they do it
en.desc: The paper introduces Quality-Controllable Policy (QCP), a robot policy that can adjust execution qualities such as speed and motion smoothness at inference time. It also proposes iterative hindsight relabeling, which measures the quality of online robot rollouts, adds successful trajectories to the training data, and fine-tunes the policy. Experiments show that this process improves both task success rates and execution quality, sometimes exceeding the quality of the original demonstrations. Real-world tests show practical benefits, including faster conveyor work and more stable transport of wine glasses.

zh.title: 让机器人按需掌控执行质量，越练越好
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出质量可控策略（QCP），让机器人在执行任务时能按需调整速度、动作平滑度等质量属性，并控制这些属性的组合。为了让策略学会超出初始示范范围的表现，研究者设计了迭代式事后重标注方法：机器人按目标质量标签在线执行任务，将成功轨迹加入数据集，再根据轨迹测得的质量重新标注并微调策略。在 Robomimic 和 RoboEval 实验中，QCP 随迭代提升了任务成功率和执行质量，生成的成功轨迹甚至优于初始示范。真实机器人实验还表明，调节速度可提高传送带作业效率，控制搬运稳定性则有助于安全运送酒杯。

papers.title: SketchDirector: Complex Scene Sketching via Agentic Layout Reasoning and Detail Refinement
papers.abstract: Abstract SketchDirector is an agentic framework that decomposes text prompts into draft vector assets, arranges them via iterative reasoning with self-evolving memory, and refines details using diffusion priors for complex scene sketching.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Existing sketch generation methods often rely on image guidance and are largely limited to individual objects or simplified scenes, leaving text-guided complex scene sketching underexplored. We present SketchDirector, an agentic framework that mimics the human sketching workflow for automatic multi-concept scene sketching. Given a scene-level text prompt, SketchDirector first employs a large language model~(LLM) to decompose the scene into multiple draft assets, where each is represented by a set of Bézier curves. Then, an agentic reasoning loop iteratively plans and executes their spatial arrangement, guided by self-evolving memory. Finally, a detail refinement module leverages diffusion priors to enhance sketch quality while preserving geometric structure. To support future research and applications in multi-concept scene sketch generation, we further introduce the MCSketch8K dataset, comprising editable vector assets, compositional layouts, and object-level manipulation annotations. Extensive experiments show that SketchDirector outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in semantic and compositional quality while effectively preserving overall contour organization during refinement. The project page is: https://yiki77.github.io/SketchDirector/{https://yiki77.github.io/SketchDirector/}.

ru.title: От текстового описания к целой сцене — эскиз, который строит AI-режиссёр
ru.desc: SketchDirector — это агентный фреймворк, который разбивает текстовый промпт сцены на несколько черновых векторных ассетов, представленных кривыми Безье. Большая языковая модель (LLM) планирует их пространственное расположение в итеративном цикле рассуждений с самообучающейся памятью (self-evolving memory). Затем модуль уточнения деталей использует диффузионные априорные знания (diffusion priors), чтобы улучшить качество эскиза и сохранить геометрическую структуру. Авторы также представляют датасет MCSketch8K с редактируемыми векторными ассетами и аннотациями для манипуляций на уровне объектов, а эксперименты показывают превосходство над современными baseline-методами по семантическому и композиционному качеству.

en.title: From Text to Thoughtfully Composed Scene Sketches
en.desc: SketchDirector turns a text description of a complex scene into a sketch containing multiple objects. A large language model breaks the scene into draft assets made from Bézier curves, and an agent iteratively arranges them using a memory that updates as it works. A refinement module uses diffusion priors to improve visual details while preserving the sketch’s overall geometry. The authors also introduce the MCSketch8K dataset, and experiments show that SketchDirector produces more semantically accurate, well-composed sketches than existing methods.

zh.title: 让智能体像人一样构思、布局并细化复杂场景草图
zh.desc: 本文提出 SketchDirector，用于根据场景级文本提示生成包含多个概念的草图。它先用大语言模型把提示拆解成多个由贝塞尔曲线表示的草稿素材，再通过带有自进化记忆的智能体推理循环规划并调整素材布局。之后，系统利用扩散模型先验细化草图，同时尽量保持原有的几何结构。作者还构建了 MCSketch8K 数据集；实验表明，该方法在语义与构图质量上优于现有基线，并能保留整体轮廓布局。

papers.title: AuditFL: A Contract-Backed Clearing Layer for Open Federated Learning
papers.abstract: Abstract AuditFL is a blockchain-backed clearing layer that makes federated learning rounds auditable and economically constrained without removing the aggregator, preserving model accuracy under failures.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Federated learning (FL) keeps raw data local, but most deployments still rely on a trusted coordinator for client admission, checkpoint distribution, update collection, aggregation, and rewards. This paper presents AuditFL, a contract-backed clearing layer for auditable FL in open settings. AuditFL keeps training and aggregation off chain, stores model artifacts in an assumed reliable off-chain artifact store, and records only content identifiers and economic state on chain. Clients reserve update tickets with deposits, publish update identifiers, and later claim refunds or rewards; the task coordinator publishes global checkpoints and finalizes rounds through deterministic settlement rules. The design does not remove the aggregator, but makes its on-chain round decisions attributable, replayable, auditable, and economically constrained. We implement AuditFL as both a deterministic state-machine prototype and a Solidity contract on a local Ethereum-compatible Anvil chain. On full MNIST with Dirichlet non-IID splits, 12 rounds, and up to 200 clients, AuditFL preserves the Plain FL learning trajectory while its overhead follows closed-form control-plane models. At 200 clients, the contract run issues 5,026 transactions, stores 2,413 off-chain artifacts (144.9 MiB), and consumes 829.7M EVM gas, dominated by per-client reserve and publish calls. Controlled dropout, invalid-update, and artifact-unavailability stress tests reduce inclusion nearly linearly but still finalize rounds, with final-accuracy changes remaining within a few tenths of an accuracy percentage point even under high injected failure rates.

ru.title: Прозрачное федеративное обучение: аудит и экономика без потери точности
ru.desc: В статье представлен AuditFL — слой клиринга на блокчейне для федеративного обучения (federated learning), который делает раунды обучения проверяемыми и экономически ограниченными, не убирая агрегатора. Обучение и агрегация выполняются вне цепочки, модели хранятся в off-chain хранилище, а в смарт-контракте фиксируются только идентификаторы контента и экономическое состояние. Прототип реализован на Solidity и протестирован на MNIST с non-IID разбиением Дирихле до 200 клиентов, при этом точность модели сохраняется даже при высоком уровне отказов.

en.title: Make Federated Learning Auditable—Without Moving Training On-Chain
en.desc: AuditFL adds a blockchain-backed clearing layer to federated learning, making round decisions auditable without replacing the aggregator. Training and model aggregation stay off-chain, while the blockchain records artifact identifiers and uses deposits, refunds, and rewards to constrain client and coordinator behavior. Experiments on MNIST show that AuditFL preserves the learning performance of plain federated learning, and rounds can still finish despite client dropouts, invalid updates, or unavailable artifacts. The main trade-off is higher control-plane cost, which grows with the number of clients because each must reserve and publish updates.

zh.title: 让联邦学习轮次可审计、可追责、受约束
zh.desc: AuditFL 是一个由智能合约支持的联邦学习结算层，让训练和模型聚合继续在链下进行，并在链上记录模型内容标识和资金状态。客户端先缴纳押金领取更新凭证，再提交更新标识，之后按规则获得退款或奖励；协调者仍负责发布全局模型并结束训练轮次。这样不会移除聚合器，但能让它的决策可追溯、可重放、可审计，并受到经济约束。在 MNIST 实验中，AuditFL 的模型效果接近普通联邦学习；即使出现客户端掉线、无效更新或模型文件不可用，训练轮次仍能结束，准确率变化也较小。

papers.title: TurnTurk-GPT: Text-Based Turn-Taking Prediction for Turkish
papers.abstract: Abstract TurnTurk-GPT, a Turkish turn-taking predictor fine-tuned from GPT-2, outperforms multilingual detectors and reveals that Turkish end-of-turn cues rely on verb-final morphology.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small This paper presents TurnTurk-GPT, a text-based turn-taking predictor for Turkish obtained by fine-tuning a Turkish GPT-2 model with the TurnGPT objective on synthetic and real dialogue, and evaluates it on real Turkish conversation against rule baselines, a zero-shot Turkish language model and a widely used multilingual end-of-turn detector. Evaluation uses word-level decision points on unpunctuated, lower-cased text approximating the output of streaming speech recognisers, recording-disjoint and speaker-disjoint folds, nested threshold selection and paired cluster bootstrap tests. TurnTurk-GPT outperforms the multilingual detector under both recording-disjoint and speaker-disjoint evaluation. It outperforms the zero-shot language model only when the test speakers occur in training; on unseen speakers the two are statistically indistinguishable. Removing the suffixes of the turn-final word reduces AP by up to 44%, against 2% for a sentence-internal word, locating the Turkish end-of-turn cue in verb-final morphology. Synthetic dialogue alone yields the weakest trained model, and when a speaker pauses the zero-shot and multilingual baselines remain close to chance. The model and the evaluation protocol are publicly released.

ru.title: В турецком конец реплики выдаёт глагольное окончание
ru.desc: Статья представляет TurnTurk-GPT — текстовый предиктор смены реплик для турецкого языка, полученный дообучением турецкой GPT-2 модели по методике TurnGPT на синтетических и реальных диалогах. Модель оценивают на реальных разговорах по сравнению с правилами, zero-shot LLM и популярным многоязычным детектором конца реплики, используя разделение по записям и по говорящим, вложенный подбор порогов и парный кластерный бутстрап. TurnTurk-GPT превосходит многоязычный детектор, а над zero-shot моделью выигрывает лишь на знакомых говорящих, тогда как на новых они статистически неразличимы. Эксперименты с удалением суффиксов показывают, что сигнал конца реплики в турецком языке заложен в глагольной морфологии в конце предложения.

en.title: Turkish Verb Endings Signal When a Speaker Is Done
en.desc: TurnTurk-GPT is a Turkish turn-taking predictor made by fine-tuning a Turkish GPT-2 model on synthetic and real dialogue. It predicts whether a speaker’s turn is ending, and performs better than a widely used multilingual detector in tests on real conversations. Its advantage over a zero-shot language model appears only when test speakers were also represented in training; for unseen speakers, their results are statistically similar. Removing suffixes from the final word sharply reduces accuracy, showing that Turkish turn endings often depend on verb-final morphology.

zh.title: 捕捉动词后缀线索，让土耳其语轮次预测更精准
zh.desc: 本文提出 TurnTurk-GPT：一种通过微调土耳其语 GPT-2、用于预测对话轮次何时结束的文本模型。研究在接近流式语音识别输出的文本上进行评估，并通过按录音和说话人划分数据、嵌套阈值选择及统计检验提升比较的可靠性。TurnTurk-GPT 在两种数据划分下均优于多语言轮次结束检测器；对于未见过的说话人，它与零样本语言模型的表现则没有显著差异。移除轮末词的后缀会使平均精度最多下降 44%，表明土耳其语的轮次结束线索主要来自动词后置结构中的形态变化。
